newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's HACTL rules out charge rate increase.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's HACTL rules out charge rate increase.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Monday it has ruled out increases in its air cargo fees for next year despite a 50 percent hike in the Consumer Price Index over the past five years.

The decision not to seek an increase next year was entirely due to constant improvements in productivity and full utilisation of automated systems, HACTL managing director Anthony Charter said in a statement.

"The company has made significant investments in technology and human resources that have not only made us the leading air cargo terminal operator in the world, but has also enabled us to maintain and indeed reduce real costs," Charter said.

HACTL is 25 percent held by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, 20 percent by Swire Pacific Ltd, 12.5 percent by Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, 12.5 percent by Hutchinson Whampoa Ltd and 10 percent each by CITIC Pacific Ltd, China National Aviation Corp and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
